mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_check (check_no, warehouse_id, product_id, book_quantity, actual_quantity, reason, status, checker_id, check_date) VALUES (#{checkNo}, #{warehouseId}, #{productId}, #{bookQuantity}, #{actualQuantity}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{checkerId}, #{checkDate})
mapper.select:
SELECT sc.*, p.product_name, p.sku_code FROM stock_check sc LEFT JOIN product p ON sc.product_id = p.id
AND company_id = #{companyId} AND sc.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND (p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sc.check_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC

SELECT CONCAT('SC', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(check_no, 11) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM stock_check WHERE check_no LIKE CONCAT('SC', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')
